Class Language

java.lang.Object
forj.Language
public final class Language extends Object
Opt-in language features, switched on per file with a static import, like Scala's import scala.language.implicitConversions: 
import static forj.Language.liftResults;     // one feature
import static forj.Language.lifting;         // all three lifting features
A file without the import behaves as if the feature didn't exist. The values themselves mean nothing; the forj plugin only looks at which of them a file imports.

Lifting

JDK types like Callable, List and Optional aren't a Kind, so code generic in F needs them wrapped (new CallableK<>(c)) and unwrapped. The lifting features let the plugin do that, using the same forjLift overloads and @Lower methods comprehensions use (forj's own in forj.For, a library's through import static).
